sourceVisualAssessment.shapeVolume: Rowan is immediately identifiable, but crown and visor read as large squared blocks; a row of angular orange fringe tips visibly cuts across the cyan brim in S and side profiles. Head/ears, palms and collar are small bevel-box forms; apron is a rigid planar slab with thin block pocket. Back hair has distinct lobes, and back cap remains rectangular. Useful native shaping can improve cap construction, connected waves, cheeks/moustache and garment tailoring within the registered envelope.
sourceVisualAssessment.color: The source already has the required light tan skin, ginger hair/moustache, cyan cap, ivory coat, green apron and teal necktie. Cyan is intensely saturated and relatively flat; green apron and tiny dark shoes become quite dark compared with the cap/face. Palette identity should survive warmer, more legible material separation.
sourceVisualAssessment.lightingHighlights: The current front is evenly readable but broad cyan planes show little soft volume. Large nearly uniform values and faceted sleeve transitions feel harder than the selected rounded, softly highlighted target. Back and profiles need equally intentional broad gradients without a preferred horizontal light direction.
sourceVisualAssessment.materialDetail: Target shows padded curved cap panels and a constructed visor, broad swept ginger locks and moustache, readable collar/cuffs, a shaped knot/tails, dimensional bib/pocket/belt and purposeful buttons. These are useful design cues; subpixel stitches/fabric grain are optional and should not compete with intended-size readability.
sourceVisualAssessment.intendedSizeReadability: All192 atlas-extracted native frames were inspected through four48-frame sheets at logical192x320 scaling and consistent diagnostic crop. Identity remains readable across all directions. Work has forward hands and a small native knife; hold/load intentionally overlay the separate fixed-facing salmon image near the face, with source occlusion dependent on direction. Source lower-body/back details are sparse; the refinement should create clear forms without obscuring action or changing contacts.
sourceVisualAssessment.artifacts: Source has purposeful low-poly facets, but cap/fringe intersection and abrupt stacked-box garment transitions are opportunities for improvement. Transparent target has fringed/colored edge artifacts and changed framing; neither should be recreated. No ground shadow should be added.
